description: A woman in a ruffled, flamenco-style dress dances with her arms raised on a round wooden table in a dim tavern, lit by a single hanging lamp. Men in flat caps and dark suits sit and stand around the table, watching, with smoke drifting in the air. A snare drum with two sticks rests in the foreground on the table. Wooden balconies and a staircase are visible in the background. There is no visible text, frame or border, and nothing graphic.
